content:
Avery: Morning — quick preflight check for the product dry-run today. Post your 3 lines: what you did, blockers, plan.
Sam: Did: finished spec for the routing fallback and validation cases. Blocker: waiting on perf numbers from eng-runtime (latency at tail). Today: wire canary flags, open CRs for rollout.
Nina: Did: UX review + copy updates for the modal and inline help. Blocker: need final wording from PM (TBD). Today: finalize copy and push to staging for smoke.
Ravi: Did: infra patch for quota enforcement merged into prod-safe. Blocker: seeing a flake on the dedupe cron job during tests. Today: debug the flake and prep infra approval for canary.
Mira: Did: added telemetry probes for token-level latency and error rates. Blocker: dashboard needs a new histogram + alert thresholds. Today: draft dashboard PR and metrics doc.
Sam: @Ravi can you review/approve infra PR (deploy gating)? it's the last blocker for my canary flags.
Ravi: On it — will review in ~30m. If it's quick I can approve before the dry-run window.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-18 03:00 UTC for model-routing dry-run. ID: canary-2026-0318.
Avery: Quick preflight checklist (post here when green): 1) CRs merged 2) infra approved 3) dashboards green 4) rollback plan documented and owner assigned.
Nina: UX smoke test added to checklist: staging modal flow passes. I ran basic clicks and flows.
Mira: Opening dashboard PR now — will include thresholds. pinging @Sam for what we consider a "green" baseline for p50/p95.
Sam: Baseline: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 200ms for the routing hop. I'll paste perf snippet if we need exact numbers.
Ravi: Flake root cause looks like concurrency on dedupe job + test ordering. Workaround: set DEDUPE_CONCURRENCY=2 in the job config for staging. Patch on prod-safe branch.
Mira: PR #3421 opened for dashboards + alerts, assigned to @Avery for review.
Avery: Will review after this async standup. If everything is green by EOD we proceed with the dry-run. Otherwise we hold. :thumbsup:
Sam: Docs updated: https://redwood/internal/docs/preflight/dryrun (added runbook and rollback steps).
Ravi: I approved infra PR and landed the concurrency workaround in staging. Running a couple of smoke runs now.
Mira: Dashboard panel rendering looks good in staging; alerts firing in the test hook as expected.
Avery: Alright — next check in ~30m. Call out any last-minute blockers here.
Sam: One last ask — can someone pair on the CR merge if I get conflicted? cc @Nina.
Nina: I can help with merge conflicts if they pop up.
Avery: Perfect, thanks everyone.
deploy-bot: Deploy window reminder scheduled: 2026-03-18 02:45 UTC (15m before canary).
